title: Task Domain Variation in Weak-to-Strong Generalization: Coding vs. Reasoning vs. Factual QA

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If weak-to-strong generalization is domain-dependent, safety guarantees from one domain cannot transfer to others. This has direct deployment implications. High safety relevance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Replicating weak-to-strong setup across three task domains using open-source code is feasible but requires sourcing and formatting three different datasets. Beginners need some guidance on dataset selection and evaluation metrics per domain.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three task domains with the same model pairs. Each domain requires dataset preparation and evaluation. Achievable but the three-domain scope is moderately ambitious for 30 hours.
